harness.seed: seed.sh <clone dir under ~/.cache/skill-eval> <with-skill 0|1>: a clone of the branch checked out where these scripts live, or of $EVAL_BRANCH
harness.check: check-<id>.sh <clone dir>: one 'PASS|FAIL <id> <what> -- <evidence>' line per check, then 'GATE env OK|TOUCHED'
harness.gate: the user's real mise is unchanged: sha256 of readlink -f ~/.config/mise/config.toml and md5 of the sorted ~/.local/share/mise/installs listing equal the values recorded in lib.sh; a TOUCHED gate voids the run, it is not scored
harness.validation: validation/validate.sh [untouched|reference|wrong] [id]: untouched clone all FAIL, reference solution (validation/ref-<id>.sh) all PASS, each sibling wrong implementation (validation/wrong.sh list) FAILs its matching check

evals.prompt: Add Zig support: zls as the language server and zig fmt as the formatter.
checks: a catalog entry provides server zls with a spec mise knows
zls is enabled with an nvim-lspconfig config and planned for zig buffers only
zig buffers format with conform's built-in zigfmt, cataloged with a spec mise knows, and no custom formatter duplicates a built-in
live: zls attaches to a Zig buffer and conform reformats it through zig fmt
regression checks needing zls and the zig formatter exist and pass with startup
the decisions doc has a Zig per-language row, install-spec rows with the catalog specs, and a decision entry
changed Lua passes stylua --check

evals.prompt: Add selene as a linter for Lua.
checks: a catalog entry provides linter selene with a spec mise knows
lua buffers lint with nvim-lint's built-in selene (no custom or duplicate definition), keep lua_ls and stylua, and other filetypes don't get selene
live: selene reports unused_variable on a Lua buffer while lua_ls is attached, and nothing on a sh buffer
a regression check needing selene exists and passes with startup
the decisions doc names selene in the Lua row, has an install-spec row with its spec, and a decision entry
changed Lua passes stylua --check

evals.prompt: Lint GitHub Dependabot config (.github/dependabot.yml) with jactionlint, only on that file.
checks: .github/dependabot.yml gets a yaml sub-filetype linted by jactionlint and still by yamllint
jactionlint runs on the Dependabot file but not on plain YAML or other .github files; workflows keep jactionlint and zizmor
yamlls still serves the Dependabot sub-filetype
live: jactionlint reports dependabot-syntax on a bad .github/dependabot.yml, yamlls attaches there, and config.yml with the same text gets no jactionlint finding
a regression check expects the Dependabot sub-filetype, and it passes with tools_subfiletypes, lint_jactionlint and startup
the decisions doc's File-scoped tools table and decision list, and CONTRIBUTING.md, name the Dependabot sub-filetype
changed Lua passes stylua --check
